name: Erbistock
text: Erbistock  (Welsh: Erbistog) is a village and community in Wrexham County Borough, Wales. The village lies on the banks of the River Dee. The community area, governed by Erbistock Community Council (Welsh: Cyngor Cymuned Erbistog) also includes the small villages of Crabtree Green and Eyton; it had a total population of 409 at the 2001 census, falling to 383 at the 2011 Census.

depictions.name: Erbistock
depictions.text: Erbistock was a fairly large Anglo-Saxon farmstead along the River Dee east of Fry's Island. It featured several buildings surrounded by numerous fields. In the 9th century, it was raided multiple times by Viking shieldmaiden Eivor Varinsdottir of the Raven Clan, Vagn, and their raiding crew on his longship.
